description: The paper doll texture roles the parts library reads every map name by (CjsCharacterTextureRoles): the regions a file name can carry and where each sits in the character atlas (a TransformUV0 rect, [u0, v0, u1, v1]); the role of each suffix (`table`: the property it draws into, what its channels hold, the composition operation or the role it is an input of, replace or add, whether it is drawn through the option's diffuse coverage, its sources, and the facts no source states, `derived`; a key `<family>_<suffix>` is a role for that family alone); and the garment map names (`garment`), searched folder first, then size tier, then name, `<part>` the part folder's name and `*` any name. Ours: Carbon ships no paper doll, and the client's is Python. Only the library loads this file. atlasTolerance: how far an authored TransformUV0 rect may lie outside an atlas region and still be placed in it; rects are authored as floats (moved from Graphene atlasRegions.js).

d.source: simpleblit: RGB = Texture.rgb, SRC_ALPHA/INV_SRC_ALPHA (character-compositing.md:370, :395); DiffuseMap (shaders.yaml partSlots)
d.derived: its alpha is coverage: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 augmentations.js:13)

channels.rgb: detail, multiplied by the colour areas

l.derived: drawn as it is (Simple) without a zone map or palette (CjsPaperDollCompositor.CreateMaterialLayer); comp_body_l is a garment detail: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 bodyComposition.js:74)

z.source: colorizedblit Z, and the one-channel compact zone decode (character-compositing.md:367, :379-383)

comp_z.source: the colorizedblit Z decode (character-compositing.md:367, :379-383); every head tattoo folder holds one `comp_head_z` beside its `projection.proj` (resource index)
comp_z.derived: PROVISIONAL (Ruru, 2026-11-09): the zone of the head tattoo's bake, which is its colourised detail (no source states it): matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 5a7e30d tattoos.js); every head tattoo's is a 16x16 map of one texel selecting colour area 1 everywhere (all 115, both sexes)

channels.rgb: normal (or two-channel: R = X, A = Y, Z rebuilt)

n.source: covered SimpleBlit replacement (character-compositing.md:593); RGB at 4k, LA at base (:337-338)
n.derived: the coverage is the option's own diffuse: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 bodyComposition.js:146, hairSupport.js:144, beardSupport.js:67, augmentations.js:14)

channels.rgba: specular (LA at base, RGBA in some variations)

s.derived: drawn by simpleblit, through the option's diffuse coverage as n; colorize_body_s is a boot's only specular: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 surfaceDetails.js:60, bodyComposition.js:63)

channels.rg: signed XY perturbation, (2 * value - 1) * strength / 2 (two-channel: A gives Y)

tn.source: twistnormalblit, two passes ONE/ONE ADD then REV_SUBTRACT, destination alpha kept (character-compositing.md:373, :397)

mn.source: maskednormalblit: XY = 2 * rg - 1, alpha = b * strength; SRC_ALPHA/INV_SRC_ALPHA, destination alpha kept (character-compositing.md:372, :396)

m.source: black RGB, variable alpha, drawn through alpha onto a white target (character-compositing.md:341-348); CutMaskMap (shaders.yaml partSlots)
m.derived: the white target and a simpleblit: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 bodyComposition.js:149, :335)
